newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Duma approves in principle gvt tax code.
newsitem.headline: Russia Duma approves in principle gvt tax code.

text.p: The State Duma lower house of the Russian parliament approved in principle on Thursday a government-proposed radical new tax code, which the cabinet says is crucial for the 1998 budget.
A total of 294 deputies voted for the resolution and only 80 against. Deputies will present amendments and then vote for the final text of the resolution later in the day.

Ministers say the new package, which aims to help business by simplifying the tax system, is vital to put shaky state finances in order and say the 1998 budget would be in jeopardy unless the Duma passed it before the summer recess.

Earlier this week the government offered the Duma a compromise, allowing deputies to present amendments to the tax code up to September after it has beeen approved in the first reading. The resolution passed by the Duma said the second reading of the bill should start on November 1.

Both government and opposition have denied rumours of a secret deal under which the Communists would back the draft while ministers would stop mentioning the possiblity of President Boris Yeltsin dissolving the legislature.
